habitat: Forest edges, secondary growth, gardens, parks, mangroves and plantations with flowering shrubs and trees; sea level to 1800 m
description: Tiny sunbird, male with crimson breast, maroon back, yellow rump and a long green-blue tail, female olive-green above with a yellowish breast; feeds on nectar (hovering briefly or perched) and insects, in forest edge, gardens and flowering shrubs.
